info.title: Herculean API
info.description: The API of Herculean, a workout log for people who train on a fixed weekly split.

post.description: Creates an account and signs it in. Name, units and default rest time are set afterwards, in setup.

201.description: The account was created and is signed in.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each field.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

patch.description: Changes the name, units, theme, color or time zone. Setup sends the name and units, Settings the others; the app sends a new time zone when the phone's changes.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

delete.description: Checks the current password, signs out every device and schedules the account for deletion in 14 days. An email says when. Signing in before then offers to keep it.

204.description: The account is scheduled for deletion.

400.description: The password is missing or wrong. The errors name the field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user. A user without a name has not finished setup.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

put.description: Sets a new password after checking the current one. This device stays signed in and every other device is signed out.

400.description: A field is not valid, or the current password is wrong. The errors name each field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

get.description: The profile photo, or null when there is none.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

put.description: Sets or replaces the profile photo.

400.description: It isn't a Base64 JPEG, or it is over 1 MB.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

delete.description: Removes the profile photo. With no photo, it changes nothing.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

post.description: Signs in with email and password and returns new tokens. The email can be in any case.

400.description: The email or password is missing.

401.description: The email or password is wrong. The message never says which.

409.description: The account is waiting to be deleted. The message says when; restoring it signs in.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

post.description: Swaps a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. The old refresh token stops working.

200.description: New tokens. Keep the new refresh token; the old one no longer works.

400.description: The refresh token is missing.

401.description: The refresh token is unknown, already used or expired. Sign in again.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

post.description: Deletes the refresh token of the device signing out. It needs no access token, because the refresh token proves it.

400.description: The token is missing.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

post.summary: Keep an account and sign in
post.description: Cancels a scheduled deletion and signs in with email and password.

200.description: The account is kept, and signed in.

400.description: The email or password is missing.

401.description: The email or password is wrong. The message never says which.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

post.description: Emails a link to set a new password. The answer is the same whether or not the email has an account, so it never tells which emails do. A new link cancels older ones.

202.description: Accepted. If the email has an account, the link is on its way.

400.description: The email is missing or not valid.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

get.description: The page the email links to. It opens the app's new password screen, or its reset password screen when the link is unknown, used or expired.

200.description: A page that opens the app.

post.description: Sets the new password with the token from the reset link. The link stops working and every device is signed out.

204.description: The password is changed. Sign in with the new one.

400.description: The token is missing, or the password is too short.

404.description: The token is unknown, already used or expired. Send a new link.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

post.description: Checks the current password and sends a link to the new address. The email changes only when the link is opened, and a new request cancels an older link.

202.description: Accepted. The link is on its way.

400.description: A field is not valid, the current password is wrong, or it is already this user's email. The errors name each field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

409.description: Another account uses this email.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

get.summary: Get the email change that is waiting
get.description: The new address whose link hasn't been opened and hasn't expired.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists.

post.summary: Send the email change link again
post.description: Sends a new link to the address that is waiting. The older link stops working.

202.description: Accepted. The link is on its way.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The account no longer exists, or no email change is waiting.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

post.description: Makes the new email active with the token from the link. It needs no sign in, because the link can be opened on another device or while signed out.

400.description: The token is missing.

404.description: The token is unknown, already used or expired. Send a new link.

409.description: Another account took this email after the link was sent.

429.description: Too many tries from this address. Wait a minute; Retry-After says how long.

get.description: The page the email links to. It opens the app's screen that confirms the new email.

200.description: A page that opens the app.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's default rest time, rest sound and rest vibrate.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

patch.description: Changes the default rest time, rest sound or rest vibrate. A new account starts at 3:00 (180 seconds), with sound and vibrate on.

200.description: The workout settings after the change.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each field.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's exercises by group order, then name. Search and group narrow the list. Deleted exercises are left out.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the exercise's name, in any case.

200.description: The exercises. Empty when none match.

400.description: The search is too long, or the group is not a valid ID.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

post.description: Adds an exercise to the signed-in user's list, in a group and with any other groups it also works.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: One of the groups does not exist.

409.description: The user already has an exercise with this name, or has reached the limit of 500 exercises.

get.description: Returns 20 of the completed workouts with checked sets of one of the signed-in user's exercises, newest first, with the months they're in. Pass nextCursor as cursor for the next 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the page before. Leave it out for the newest sessions.

200.description: A page of sessions. Empty when the exercise hasn't been done.

400.description: The cursor isn't one from an earlier page.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

get.description: Returns the sets of one of the signed-in user's exercises in its latest completed workout before a date.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only workouts before this date count, such as the date of the workout it's added to.

200.description: Its last time, or null when it wasn't done before the date.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

get.description: Returns the heaviest set of each completed workout with checked sets of one of the signed-in user's exercises, over a range up to today, oldest first. A range with more than 60 sessions returns each month's heaviest set instead.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: How far back to read, up to today: 3m, 6m, 1y or all. Leave it out for 3m.

200.description: The heaviest sets. Empty when the range has no sessions.

400.description: The range isn't 3m, 6m, 1y or all.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

get.description: Returns one of the signed-in user's exercises, with its group and the other groups it also works.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

put.description: Replaces the name, the group and the other groups an exercise also works. Changes show everywhere it is used.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise or one of the groups does not exist.

409.description: The user already has another exercise with this name.

delete.description: Removes an exercise from the signed-in user's list. Logged workouts keep it, and its name can be used again.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise does not exist, is already deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The exercise is in a routine.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's groups in their order. Deleted groups are left out. A new account starts with six.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

post.description: Adds a group at the end of the signed-in user's groups.

400.description: The name is not valid.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

409.description: The user already has a group with this name, or has reached the limit of 50 groups.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's routines by their first planned weekday, then name, with the unplanned ones last. Deleted routines are left out.

200.description: The routines. Empty when there are none.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

post.description: Adds a routine with its exercises and targets to the signed-in user's list. It is planned on the weekdays it names, from today.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: One of the exercises does not exist.

409.description: The user already has a routine with this name, or has reached the limit of 50 routines.

get.description: Returns one of the signed-in user's routines, with the weekdays it is planned on and its exercises and targets in order.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The routine does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

put.description: Replaces a routine's name, weekdays, exercises, order and targets. Weekdays change from today, and workouts already started keep what they copied.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The routine or one of the exercises does not exist.

409.description: The user already has another routine with this name.

delete.description: Removes a routine from the signed-in user's list. Its weekdays read as rest days while it is deleted, logged workouts keep their name, and its name can be used again.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The routine does not exist, is already deleted, or belongs to another user.

post.description: Brings a deleted routine back, on the weekdays that still hold it.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The routine does not exist, is not deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: Another routine has its name now, or one of its exercises was deleted.

get.description: Returns what each weekday holds now for the signed-in user, always seven days from Monday. A day with no routine is a rest day.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

get.description: Returns each date's status from the first date to the last, for the signed-in user, in their time zone.

400.description: A date is missing or not valid, the last date is before the first, or the range is over 42 days.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

get.description: Returns the first day the signed-in user can reach: the earlier of their first workout and the day their account was created.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

get.description: Returns a date's status for the signed-in user, in their time zone, with its routine and the day after it.

400.description: The date is not a valid date.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

get.description: Returns a month's counts and totals for the signed-in user, in their time zone.

400.description: The month is not a valid month.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

post.description: Starts or skips a workout on a date for the signed-in user. The date is today or a past day, in the user's time zone. It uses the day's planned routine, or when starting, a routine picked for this date only, which leaves the week plan as it is. The workout copies the routine's name, exercises and targets. A started workout's sets begin from last time.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The picked routine does not exist.

409.description: The date already has a workout, is in the future, is before the first day when picking a routine, or has no routine planned. Or, when starting, the routine has no exercises left or another workout is in progress.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's workouts with a status, newest first. Deleted workouts are left out. Only one workout can be in progress, so inProgress returns at most one.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only workouts that stand here. Only inProgress for now.

200.description: The workouts. Empty when none match.

400.description: The status is missing or not inProgress.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

delete.description: Removes a workout from the signed-in user's date, which is how a skip is undone. The day then reads from the week plan again.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout does not exist, is already deleted, or belongs to another user.

put.description: Replaces a saved workout's exercises and sets with the ones sent, in their order. Exercises left out are removed; new ones get the starting targets. Every set counts as done.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout, a workout exercise or an added exercise does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout isn't saved.

patch.description: Saves a workout in progress as completed. Unchecked sets are removed, and so is any exercise left with no sets.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress, or none of its sets are checked.

get.description: Returns one of the signed-in user's workouts, with its exercises and sets in order, and each exercise's last time.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

post.description: Brings a deleted workout back on its date, as it was.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout does not exist, is not deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: Its date has another workout now, or another workout is in progress.

get.description: Returns what one of the signed-in user's workouts comes to: its duration, sets, volume, unchecked exercises and new records.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

post.description: Adds a set to an exercise in a workout in progress. An empty object adds a copy of the last set. Sending a removed set puts it back where it was. An exercise has at most 20 sets.

parameters.name: workoutExerciseId
parameters.description: The exercise's ID in the workout.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout or the exercise does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress, or the exercise has 20 sets.

patch.description: Changes a set's weight or reps, or checks or unchecks it, in a workout in progress. A changed value also changes later unchecked sets of the exercise, unless they were changed by hand. Returns all of the exercise's sets.

parameters.name: workoutExerciseId
parameters.description: The exercise's ID in the workout.

200.description: All of the exercise's sets, in order.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout, exercise or set does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress.

delete.description: Removes a set from an exercise in a workout in progress, and closes the gap in the order. An exercise keeps at least one set.

parameters.name: workoutExerciseId
parameters.description: The exercise's ID in the workout.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout, exercise or set does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress, or this is the exercise's last set.

post.description: Adds exercises at the end of a workout in progress, at 3 × 8–10, with sets from last time. Sending a removed exercise instead puts it back where it was, with its sets. A workout has at most 30 exercises, each once.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout or an exercise does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress, has no room, or already has one of the exercises.

delete.summary: Remove an exercise from a workout
delete.description: Removes an exercise and its sets from a workout in progress, and closes the gap in the order. The last one can go too.

parameters.name: workoutExerciseId
parameters.description: The exercise's ID in the workout.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout or the exercise does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress.

patch.summary: Swap an exercise in a workout
patch.description: Swaps an exercise with no checked sets for another, keeping the set count and targets. Its sets start from the new exercise's last time. Sending the sets' earlier values puts them back, which is how a swap is undone.

parameters.name: workoutExerciseId
parameters.description: The exercise's ID in the workout.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout or an exercise does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress, already has the new exercise, or the exercise has checked sets.

put.description: Puts the exercises of a workout in progress in this order. It has to name each of them once.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each one.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The workout does not exist, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The workout is not in progress, or its exercises have changed.

get.description: Returns one of the signed-in user's groups, with the exercises that belong to it and the ones that also work it. Deleted exercises are left out.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The group does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

patch.description: Changes a group's name. It shows on every chip and section.

400.description: The name is not valid.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The group does not exist, is deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: The user already has another group with this name.

delete.description: Removes a group no exercise uses. It can be restored, and its name can be used again.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The group does not exist, is already deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: An exercise uses the group, as its group or as also works.

post.description: Brings a deleted exercise back to the signed-in user's list.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The exercise does not exist, is not deleted, or belongs to another user, or one of its groups is gone.

409.description: Another exercise has its name now.

post.description: Brings a deleted group back in the place it had.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

404.description: The group does not exist, is not deleted, or belongs to another user.

409.description: Another group has its name now.

put.summary: Change the order of the groups
put.description: Sets the order of the signed-in user's groups, which orders the exercise list and the chips.

400.description: The list repeats a group.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access token expired.

409.description: The list doesn't match the user's groups, which have changed.

oneOf.description: The removed set to put back, which is how a removal is undone. Left out, the new set copies the last set.

AddSetRequest.description: A set to add to an exercise.

exerciseIds.description: The exercises to add at the end, with the starting targets. Their sets start from last time.

oneOf.description: The removed exercise to put back, which is how a removal is undone.

AddWorkoutExercisesRequest.description: Exercises to add to a workout: new ones, or a removed one to put back.

weightKg.description: The weight in kg. A bodyweight set has 0.

date.description: The date of the first workout that did it, in the user's time zone.

BestSetResponse.description: The best set of an exercise.

currentPassword.description: The password the user has now.

newPassword.description: The new password, at least 8 characters.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token this device holds now. Every other one is deleted.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: The current and new passwords, and the refresh token of the device that stays signed in.

Color.description: The accent color of buttons, links and highlights.

token.description: The token from the reset link. It works once.

password.description: The new password, at least 8 characters.

CompletePasswordResetRequest.description: The token from the reset link, and the new password.

token.description: The token from the link. It works once.

ConfirmEmailChangeRequest.description: The token from the link in the email.

name.description: The name, 1 to 100 characters. Spaces around it are removed. It must differ from the user's other exercises, regardless of case.

groupId.description: The group it belongs to, which orders the exercise list.

alsoWorksGroupIds.description: Other groups it also works. Optional. It can't repeat a group, or include the group it belongs to.

name.description: The name, 1 to 30 characters. Spaces around it are removed. It must differ from the user's other groups, regardless of case.

CreatePasswordResetRequest.description: Where to send the password reset link.

name.description: The name, 1 to 100 characters. Spaces around it are removed. It must differ from the user's other routines, regardless of case.

weekdays.description: The weekdays it is on from today, which can be none. Another routine on one of them loses that day.

exercises.description: Its exercises in order, 1 to 30, each once.

email.description: The account's email, in any case.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Email and password to sign in with.

email.description: Unique regardless of case. At most 254 characters.

timeZone.description: The phone's IANA time zone, for example Europe/Zagreb.

status.description: Where it starts: in progress to log it, or skipped.

routineId.description: The routine to start instead of the day's plan, for this date only. Only when starting. Without it, the day's planned routine is used.

CreateWorkoutRequest.description: A workout to add to a date.

groupId.description: The ID of the group it belongs to.

groupName.description: The name of the group it belongs to.

targetRepsFrom.description: The low end of the rep range.

targetRepsTo.description: The high end of the rep range.

DayExerciseResponse.description: An exercise in a day's routine and its targets.

hasRoutines.description: Whether the user has any routine. Without one, the app offers to create it.

workoutId.description: The day's workout, which is how a workout is resumed or a skip undone. Null when it has none.

oneOf.description: The routine planned on this day, or the one its workout came from. Null on a rest day.

DayResponse.description: One day: its status, its routine and the day after it.

DayRoutineResponse.description: A routine planned on a day.

routineName.description: The name of the routine planned on it. Null on a rest day.

DaySummaryResponse.description: A day's status, for the week strip.

currentPassword.description: The password the user has now.

DeleteCurrentUserRequest.description: The password that proves it's the user asking.

id.description: The workout exercise's ID, or null for an exercise added while editing.

sets.description: Its sets in order, 1 to 20. Every set of a saved workout counts as done.

EditedWorkoutExercise.description: An exercise of the edited workout.

weightKg.description: The weight in kg, 0 to 1,000 with up to two decimals. 0 means bodyweight.

EditedWorkoutSet.description: A set of the edited workout.

exercises.description: Its exercises in order, 1 to 30, each exercise once. Exercises left out are removed.

EditWorkoutRequest.description: A saved workout as edited: all its exercises in order, each with all its sets.

alsoWorksGroups.description: The other groups it also works, in their order.

routines.description: The routines that have it, by name. It can't be deleted while there are any.

oneOf.description: The heaviest weight, then the most reps at that weight, from checked sets in completed workouts. Null until the exercise has been done.

timesDone.description: The number of completed workouts with a checked set of it.

firstDoneOn.description: The date of the first of those workouts, in the user's time zone. Null until the exercise has been done.

ExerciseDetailsResponse.description: An exercise, its groups and its progress.

oneOf.description: Its latest completed workout before the date. Null when it wasn't done before then.

ExerciseLastTimeResponse.description: An exercise's sets the last time it was done.

groupName.description: The name of the group it belongs to.

oneOf.description: The heaviest weight, then the most reps at that weight, from checked sets in completed workouts. Null until the exercise has been done.

byMonth.description: True when the range has too many sessions to show each, so each point is a month's heaviest set.

points.description: Each session's heaviest set, or each month's when byMonth is true, oldest first. Empty when the range has no sessions.

ExerciseProgressResponse.description: An exercise's heaviest sets over a range, oldest first.

alsoWorksGroupIds.description: The other groups it also works.

date.description: The workout's date, in the user's time zone.

sets.description: The checked sets, in their order.

ExerciseSessionResponse.description: A completed workout with checked sets of the exercise.

months.description: Every month this page has sessions in, newest first, with all of that month's sessions counted.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

ExerciseSessionsResponse.description: A page of an exercise's sessions, newest first.

date.description: The earlier of the first workout and the day the account was created, in the user's time zone.

FirstDayResponse.description: The first day the user can reach.

exercises.description: The exercises that belong to it, by name.

alsoWorksExercises.description: The exercises that also work it, by name.

GroupDetailsResponse.description: A group and the exercises that use it.

exerciseCount.description: How many exercises use it, as their group or as also works. It can only be deleted at 0.

GroupResponse.description: A muscle group. It orders the exercise list and the chips.

LastTimeResponse.description: An exercise's sets the last time it was done.

weightKg.description: The weight in kg. 0 means bodyweight.

missed.description: Planned days that passed with nothing logged.

minutesTrained.description: The sum of workout durations, in minutes.

setsPlanned.description: The target sets of planned days so far.

volumeKg.description: Weight times reps over all sets, in kilograms.

plannedDays.description: Planned days so far: past days, plus today once its workout is done or skipped.

consistencyPercent.description: Done days out of planned days so far, from 0 to 100. Null with no planned days yet.

fromRoutine.description: The name of the routine it moved from.

MovedDayResponse.description: A weekday that moved to this routine from another one.

newEmail.description: The address waiting to be confirmed, or null when none is.

PendingEmailChangeResponse.description: The email change waiting for its link to be opened.

type.description: A link to the HTTP status in RFC 9110.

title.description: The HTTP status name, for example Conflict.

detail.description: A sentence that explains the error.

code.description: A stable code for the app, for example user.email_taken. Field errors have validation.

errors.description: Only when the code is validation: messages per field, with field names as in the request.

traceId.description: Finds the request in the logs.
